text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: service=inference-controlplane region=us-west-2 metric=p99_latency value=2.5s threshold=1.5s — streaming stalls observed on /v1/stream and degraded tail latency on generation routes. Started ~1812467985.
charlie-oncall: i'm on it, paging oncall list, will triage. any known deploys?
alice.sre: seeing a big jump in auth DB read latency around the same time. p95 ~150ms -> 1.2s, p99 ~2.5s. also config-fetch 5xx rate increased, KV cache hit % dropped ~18%.
ben.runtime: looks like feature-flag configfetch failing intermittently, so runtime is falling back to full config read path which hits auth service on every request. that explains tail.
danielle.prodops: hmm, auth DB RPS also spiked ~3x. might be a cascading retry loop from config client.
charlie-oncall: impact? which customers/routes?
sam.cust-succ: early telemetry from alerts -> a few high-traffic customers (org-1972, org-0091) seeing elevated errors/timeouts for streaming. customer success notified those accounts already.
alice.sre: p95 generation latency across region: baseline 150ms -> 1.25s. streaming stall rate ~ 6% of sessions failing to stream tokens for >5s. not yet full outage but SLO breach for p99.
ben.runtime: quick mitigation options: 1) flip featureflag to force local config cache (avoid configservice call path) 2) temporarily increase auth service rate limits / scale read replicas 3) enable fallback model routing to smaller model to reduce controlplane calls.
danielle.prodops: i'll spin an auth-read replica and bump RPS quota for internal controlplane service. doing now, will update when up.
charlie-oncall: assigned to ben and alice for runtime + sres. danielle taking infra scale. sam continue CS comms. handoff/notes for night -> @tina.eng-ml will pick up after me.
ben.runtime: performing featureflag toggle to disable dynamic config fetch for rollout clients. command:`​``bash
# set ff:controlplane.dynamic_config = false
curl -X POST "https://flags.redwood.internal/api/flags/ff.controlplane.dynamic_config" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"value": false}'
`​``
deploy-bot: deploy started for featureflag change by ben.runtime at 1812468120 — rollout 100% in us-west-2.
ben.runtime: toggle applied, forcing local cached config. monitoring effect on calls to config service.
alice.sre: after toggle, config-fetch 5xxs dropped ~80% in last 40s, auth DB read QPS down ~55%. p95 now ~210ms, p99 trending down. nice.
danielle.prodops: auth read-replica up and attached @1812468235, increased read capacity + connection pool.
sam.cust-succ: noted — preparing short customer note for impacted orgs: saying we saw a transient control-plane latency spike, mitigations applied, postmortem to follow.
charlie-oncall: continuing to watch for 15m. any further risky actions?
ben.runtime: still seeing some streaming stalls — likely some clients hit retry loops; suggest we temporarily enable streaming fallback that uses buffered send when KV cache miss rather than abort. small runtime patch can be turned on via config. rolling enabling on 10% nodes now.
tina.eng-ml: @charlie-oncall i'll take post-handoff at 1812468400 UTC. i'll keep an eye overnight and collect logs for model routing regressions. please drop any troubleshooting queries in this thread.
alice.sre: collecting traces for a few sample requests that showed >5s tail; saving to /var/trace/incident-1812468000.tar.gz and uploading to the incident bucket.
charlie-oncall: summary so far: cause = increased config-fetch failures causing controlplane to hit auth DB on each request -> auth DB surge -> tail latency + streaming stalls. mitigations applied: featureflag toggle to cache configs, auth read-replica + quota bump, runtime streaming fallback rollout. impact: elevated p95/p99 for ~15-30m; streaming stall rate peaked ~6%; affected some high-traffic customers (org-1972, org-0091). next steps: postmortem, add circuit-breaker around config-fetch, increase config cache TTL, fix retry storm in config client.
sam.cust-succ: i'll send customer note now and offer status update call if they request.
charlie-oncall: handing over to @tina.eng-ml at 1812468400 for overnight. final state at handoff: p99 ~320ms, streaming stall rate back to ~0.8%. will reopen if regressions. :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigations applied (featureflag toggle, auth replica) at 1812468235; degraded metrics improving.
charlie-oncall: thanks all — great triage. please file a postmortem with timeline + RCA and link to this thread.
tina.eng-ml: acknowledged, i'll take ownership of the postmortem draft and ping eng-runtime for root-cause analysis in morning.
ben.runtime: leaving a note: add a short-circuit check in runtime: if configfetch fails 3x, fallback to cached and mark unhealthy to avoid retries. will prototype tomorrow.
alice.sre: adding monitoring alerts: new alert for configservice 5xx rate >1% and auth DB read latency spike >500ms.
danielle.prodops: closing auth-scale task, will monitor costs and revert replica if not needed.
charlie-oncall: last check @1812468530: system stable for now. handoff complete.
